picks.readme:
# Aerial **给国产电视的一块干净桌面。** 参照 Apple TV 做的 Android TV 桌面：没有广告，没有推荐流，只有你的 App、壁纸和航拍屏保。
适合小米、TCL、创维、索尼等国产电视，也能装在盒子和投影仪上。开机自动进入，待机也不会被清理。 **中文** · [English](README.en.md) ![Aerial 首页](site/img/home.jpg) | 电视自带的桌面 | 换上 Aerial 之后 | |:---:|:---:| | | |
## 功能

- **首页**：常用的一排 App 放在屏幕下方的玻璃底板上，往下是全部 App。小米「应用中心」「米家」这类藏起来的系统 App 也在。 - **整理**：长按 OK 键（或按菜单键）可以移动、放进文件夹、隐藏、卸载，或者设成「开机时打开」（开机、待机醒来直接进这个 App 或信号源）。固定到主屏幕的 HDMI 可以选接的是 Apple TV、PlayStation、Switch、Xbox、电脑等，换成对应的图标，也能在手机上起名字。 - **用手机整理**：扫电视上的二维码，手机上就是和电视一样的图标网格：按住拖动排序，点一下改名、换图标、放进文件夹或隐藏，也能把 HDMI 等信号源加到主屏幕。 - **图标库**：常用 App 直接用做好的 16:9 磁贴图，一个 App 可以有好几张，在手机上点开 App 挑，每张都写着来源。图来自 [le5inioo](https://github.com/le5inioo) 画的一套（[#706](https://github.com/pengchujin/aerial-tv/issues/706)）、App 自己的 tvOS 版图标、Aerial 自己画的系统 App 图标和当贝桌面。 - **控制中心**：在第一排按上键到右上角打开，有信号源、网络、设置、音量、亮度和个性化。 - **屏保**：Apple TV 的 114 段航拍影片，电视支持时播 4K 或 4K 杜比视界，也可以换成照片、时钟或从手机添加的本地视频（[说明](docs/SCREENSAVER_VIDEOS.md)）。 - **壁纸**：必应每日精选、14 张内置壁纸、用手机扫码传的照片和视频，或者航拍：停在主屏幕 10 秒后在磁贴后面播放，按任意键停在当前画面。 - **个性化**：每排 4、5 或 6 个 App，单排或双排、时钟大小和位置、App 名称、焦点样式、按键声音，都能改。

## 安装 不用 root，不动系统应用，随时能还原。电脑和电视连同一个网络。 ### 1. 打开电视的 ADB 调试 | 电视 | 怎么打开 | |---|---| | **小米 / Redmi** | 设置 → 关于 → 连续按「产品型号/产品类型」进入开发者模式，再到 设置 → 账号与安全，打开「ADB 调试」和「安装未知来源的应用」 | | **TCL / 雷鸟** | 设置 → 关于 → 本机信息，快速按遥控器「上下左右」，在底部的「更多」里打开 ADB | | **海尔 / 模卡** | 按电视机身上的信号源键，再用遥控器按「左左上右」，在工厂菜单里打开「ADB 调试开关」，别动其他选项 | | **海信 / Vidda** | 设置 → 声音，关闭杜比全景声；在 专业音响设置 → 声音平衡 里快速交替按「确认」「菜单」，左上角出现 M 后按「菜单」进工厂菜单，把「选项」里的 To Fac 从 U 改成 M 后重启，别动其他选项；再到 设置 → 全部设置，连按「菜单」打开原生设置，连按版本号后在开发者选项里打开「USB 调试」和「无线调试」。工厂菜单按错有风险，反复改 To Fac 可能让 USB 失灵、要重置电视，只改一次（[详细](docs/devices/adb-by-brand.md)） | | **OPPO（含 S1）** | 设置 → 系统 → 关于本机 → 设备型号，按「上上右右」再按确认；再到 设置 → 系统 → 开发者选项，打开「USB 调试」。IP 在 设置 → 网络 → 已连接的网络 最下面 | | **其他 Android TV** | 设置 → 设备偏好设置 → 关于 → 连按「内部版本号」7 次，再在开发者选项里打开「USB 调试」 | 电视的 IP 在「设置 → 网络 → 已连接的网络」里。第一次连接时，有 USB 调试开关的电视会问是否允许调试，选「始终允许」；只有无线调试的电视不弹这个窗，见下一段。 **只有无线调试、没有 USB 调试 / 网络调试（ADB 调试）开关的 Android 11+ 电视，第一次要先配对**（例如索尼 BRAVIA 的 Android 14，#747）：这类电视不提供旧的明文端口，不能直接 `adb connect :5555`。在电视上打开 设置 → 系统 → 开发者选项 → **无线调试** → **使用配对码配对设备**，把配对码屏幕上的 IP:端口和 6 位配对码输入电脑： ```bas

picks.readme:
The IDE you know, rebuilt in Rust.

Download  ·  Docs  ·  Benchmark  ·  Plugins  ·  Community  ·  Sponsor

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/234dd54c-1255-4b3a-b35c-533d78d737c0 OpenIDEA brings the IntelliJ IDEA way of working — its keymap, its tool windows, its search-everything habits — to a native app with a Rust core. Editor, code insight, debugger, Git, terminal, database and HTTP clients, for 60+ languages. Builds for macOS, Windows and Linux. ## Benchmark Opening [freqtrade](https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade) (Python, ~770 files) with warm caches, median of 5 runs: | | OpenIDEA | IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.3 | | --------------------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------- | | Window with the project | **0.9 s** | 3.1 s | | Ready (CPU settled) | **1.1 s** | 13.2 s | | Memory (USS, all processes) | **169 MB** | 2011 MB | | CPU time until ready | **2.4 s** | 47.9 s | | Idle CPU | **4 %** of a core | 7 % of a core | | Quit | **0.3 s** | 5.9 s | A release build of OpenIDEA from `main` and IDEA with default settings and plugins, on Windows 11, 32-core AMD, 62 GB RAM. IDEA analyses Python more deeply, so "ready" doesn't mean the same work on both sides. Both are measured from the outside, the same way: see [`perf/compare`](perf/compare) to run it on your machine and projects. ## Plugins Plugins add actions, completion, quick fixes, tool windows, custom editors, themes, file icons and languages. They run as sandboxed WebAssembly components; themes, icon themes and languages need no code at all. Install them from Settings › Plugins, or start your own with `openidea-plugin new` — see [Writing OpenIDEA plugins](https://openidea.sh/en/plugins) and the [official plugins](plugins/official). The plugin API is still a preview. ## Community - [Discord](https://discord.gg/2Zy4yn7gP) — questions, feedback and release news. - WeChat group — scan to join: - Contributing: see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [contributor docs](https://openidea.sh/en/contribute/setup). ## Sponsor If OpenIDEA saves you time, you can support its development with Alipay or WeChat Pay.

picks.readme:
# Skills For Real Engineers [![skills.sh](https://skills.sh/b/mattpocock/skills)](https://skills.sh/mattpocock/skills) My agent skills that I use every day to do real engineering - not vibe coding. Developing real applications is hard. Approaches like GSD, BMAD, and Spec-Kit try to help by owning the process. But while doing so, they take away your control and make bugs in the process hard to resolve. These skills are designed to be small, easy to adapt, and composable. They work with any model. They're based on decades of engineering experience. Hack around with them. Make them your own. Enjoy. If you want to keep up with changes to these skills, and any new ones I create, you can join ~60,000 other devs on my newsletter: [Sign Up To The Newsletter](https://www.aihero.dev/s/skills-newsletter) ## Installation (30-second setup) A plugin updates itself. [skills.sh](https://skills.sh/mattpocock/skills) copies editable files into your project, and you update them by hand. Pick one per agent, because installing both gives you every skill twice. ### 1. Get the skills
Claude Code ```bash claude plugin install mattpocock-skills@claude-plugins-official ``` Updates itself by default.
Codex ```bash codex plugin marketplace add mattpocock/skills codex plugin add mattpocock-skills@mattpocock ``` Updates itself at startup.
GitHub Copilot (CLI and VS Code) ```bash copilot plugin marketplace add mattpocock/skills copilot plugin install mattpocock-skills@mattpocock ``` Then, once, add to `~/.copilot/settings.json`: ```json { "extraKnownMarketplaces": { "mattpocock": { "source": { "source": "github", "repo": "mattpocock/skills" }, "autoUpdate": true } } } ``` In VS Code, run **Chat: Install Plugin From Source** and enter `https://github.com/mattpocock/skills`. It updates daily.
Gemini CLI (manual updates) ```bash gemini skills install https://github.com/mattpocock/skills.git --path skills/engineering gemini skills install https://github.com/mattpocock/skills.git --path skills/productivity ``` Re-run both commands to update.
Any other agent, or editable files (manual updates) ```bash npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills -a # cursor, opencode, devin, windsurf, amp, pi; omit -a to choose ``` When the installer asks which skills to take, include `setup-matt-pocock-skills`. To update, run `npx skills@latest update`, and re-run `add` to pick up new skills.
### 2. Run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` In your agent, run it once per repo. It will: - Ask you which issue tracker you want to use (GitHub, GitLab, local files, or anything else you describe) - Ask you what labels you apply to tickets when you triage them (`/triage` uses labels) - Ask you where you want to save any docs we create ### 3. Bam - you're ready to go. ## Why These Skills Exist I built these skills as a way to fix common failure modes I see with Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents. ### #1: The Agent Didn't Do What I Want > "No-one knows exactly what they want" > > David Thomas & Andrew Hunt, [The Pragmatic Programmer](https://www.amazon.co.uk/Pragmatic-Programmer-Anniversary-Journey-Mastery/dp/B0833F1T3V)

picks.readme:
# HermesEnabler 2

[English](README.md) · [한국어](README.ko.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [Français](README.fr.md) · [Deutsch](README.de.md) · [Português](README.pt.md)

![](image.png)

> Supported only on watchOS 27.0 through 27.3 beta 1.

## Installation

### Install the IPA

1. Download the IPA from [Releases](https://github.com/pookjw/HermesEnabler/releases).
2. Install it with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io).
3. On your iPhone, open the **Watch** app and install **HermesEnabler2** from **My Watch → Apps**.
4. Open **HermesEnabler2** on your Apple Watch and follow the steps in the app.

### Build with Xcode

1. Open [HermesEnabler2.xcodeproj](HermesEnabler2.xcodeproj) in Xcode.
2. Select your Apple Watch as the run destination and click **Run**.
3. Open **HermesEnabler2** on your Apple Watch and follow the steps in the app.

## Cautions

- In Sideloadly, disable **Use automatic bundle ID** and use a fixed Bundle Identifier. Keep the same Bundle Identifier and Apple ID for every update so the app can retain its existing data and backup.
- Before deleting the app, always restore your MobileGestalt backup through the HermesEnabler2 app.

## Credits

This project incorporates code from [Gester](https://github.com/sasobhabha/Gester).

Use at your own risk.

picks.desc: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
picks.readme:
# Astryx An open source design system that's fully customizable and built for how we build now:
by people and the agents working alongside them. **Currently in Beta** · Built on [React 19+](https://react.dev) and [StyleX](https://stylexjs.com) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@astryxdesign/core?label=npm&color=cb3837&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@astryxdesign/core) [![license MIT](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@astryxdesign/core?color=blue)](LICENSE) [![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/meta/astryx/wiki/Contributing) [![Docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docs-astryx.atmeta.com-6741d9?logo=readthedocs&logoColor=white)](https://astryx.atmeta.com) [![Storybook](https://img.shields.io/badge/Storybook-live-ff4785?logo=storybook&logoColor=white)](https://astryx.atmeta.com/storybook/) [![Sandbox](https://img.shields.io/badge/Sandbox-playground-A9792B)](https://astryx.atmeta.com/sandbox/) **[Docs](https://astryx.atmeta.com)** · **[Storybook](https://astryx.atmeta.com/storybook/)** · **[Sandbox](https://astryx.atmeta.com/sandbox/)** · **[Contributing](https://github.com/meta/astryx/wiki/Contributing)** · **[Discord](https://discord.com/invite/XnsUcFykEP)**
## Overview Astryx is an open source design system that grew inside Meta over the last eight years, where it became the most-used and largest design system in the company — powering 13,000+ apps and shaped by the engineers, designers, and product teams who depend on it every day. It ships 150+ accessible components, brand-level theming, dark mode, ready-to-ship templates, and a CLI as one cohesive system. You import pre-built CSS and use typed React components — no build plugin, no styling library to adopt — and both people and AI assistants build with the same tooling. **What makes Astryx different:** - **Open internals.** Components are built to be composed at any level, not locked behind a closed top-level API. The building blocks you'd reach for are exported directly, and when you need to go deeper, swizzle ejects a component's full source into your project to own. - **No styling lock-in.** Astryx authors its styles with StyleX, but that's invisible to consumers. Override with `className` using Tailwind, CSS modules, or plain CSS — whatever your project already uses. - **Customize without wrapping.** A theme is a set of CSS custom property overrides, so a designer can make Astryx unmistakably theirs without forking or wrapping component source. - **Built for people and agents.** The API, docs, and CLI are designed together so a person and an AI assistant build the same way, from the same reference. ## Getting Started Astryx requires **React 19** or later (`react` and `react-dom` are peer dependencies of `@astryxdesign/core`). Install Astryx, a theme, and its peer dependencies: ```bash # npm npm install @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex npm install -D @astryxdesign/cli # pnpm pnpm add @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex pnpm add -D @astryxdesign/cli # yarn yarn add @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex yarn add -D @astryxdesign/cli ``` You can also install the CLI once for your computer, so `astryx` works in any folder and every coding agent knows Astryx; in a project, it still runs that project's own version: ```bash npm i -g @astryxdesign/cli ``` Project install, global install, or both? `astryx docs global/project-global-or-both` compares them (both is recommended), and `astryx docs global` explains how global mode works. The simplest setup is a few CSS imports plus a theme provider — no build plugin, no PostCSS or Babel config. See the **[@astryxdesign/core README](packages/core/READ
